A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same CCA-Attention research, with 20 pages including Appendices A–C. Complete text comparison and rendered-page checks establish that differences are confined to pages 1 and 9.

before.justification: v2 reports original CCA-LLM benchmark scores, latency and memory measurements, and ablation results in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark, efficiency, and ablation results in Section 4 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same globality-aware pooling, locality-preserving attention, differentiable fusion, inference procedure, and training strategies.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage remains unchanged: SlimPajama, LongBench-E, multi-document QA, RULER, MMLU, and Proof-pile, including the scenarios documented in Appendices B and C.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain identical comparator membership, including full self-attention, StreamingLLM, LM-Infinite, MInference, and the LongLoRA comparison in Table 5.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B retain the same model configurations, context lengths, evaluation metrics, testing procedures, and 1,000-step fine-tuning budget. Appendix experiment settings also remain identical.

E4.justification: The inference-flexibility analysis, attention visualizations, pooling/group-size/window-size/updating-strategy ablations, and convergence analysis are unchanged in Section 4.3 and Appendix C.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate tables and unbanded curves. Neither introduces seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries and plotted findings are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, Table 3 retains CCA-LLM's 128K EM score of 32.0 and first-token latency of 15.89 seconds in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and complexity analysis in Section 3, and the reachability definition, Proposition 1, and proof in Appendix A, are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about plug-and-play integration, global/local context modeling, accuracy, and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, applicability discussions, and efficiency–accuracy tradeoffs remain unchanged. The shortened Impact Statement retains the same speed, accuracy, and sustainability interpretation.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is unchanged, including Triton, A800 hardware, training budgets, hyperparameters, and Appendix B protocols. The source-code hyperlink retains the same target.

R1.justification: Section 2, research positioning, and the reference list are identical. No prior works are added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 changes the author spelling from Yiru Li to Yirui Li, updates the version/date stamp, adds the CPSF fellowship acknowledgment, and shortens the Impact Statement, including removing 'breakthrough'. Section organization remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Author-line spacing changes slightly, and the additional acknowledgment line shifts the Impact Statement downward on page 9. Figures, tables, captions, and their placement are unchanged; all other pages are pixel-identical.

improvement.justification: The author/funding updates and shorter Impact Statement are limited editorial changes. The scientific arguments, experimental evidence, and reproducibility information remain identical, yielding no meaningful net change in overall paper quality.
